dont_vtswitch.description: Prevents VT switching, recommended for X11 sessions managed by xrdp.

auto_add_devices.description: Disables automatic input device addition, as xrdp handles input devices.

horiz_sync.description: Horizontal sync range for the virtual monitor.

vert_refresh.description: Vertical refresh range for the virtual monitor.

drm_device.description: Path to the DRM render node for hardware acceleration.

dri3.description: Enables DRI3 extension for better performance.

drm_allow_list.description: Comma-separated list of DRM drivers allowed for hardware acceleration.

gpu_device.description: GPU device path, usually empty for xrdp virtual device.

default_depth.description: Default color depth for the screen.

modes.description: List of supported screen resolution modes.
